lines.text: Fuss and arguments about small things.
I don't want any drama this year.

data.mean: Fuss and arguments about small things.
data.define: Needless trouble or arguments between people.

misuse.text: Don't call your friend's real problem 'drama'.
misuse.why: It makes serious feelings sound silly.
